judgments.reason: The span 'systemic chemotherapy: paclitaxel and bevacizumab administered for 63 and 36 days before presentation' appears literally in the vignette and supports the chemotherapy-associated etiology of the sclerosing cholangitis diagnosis.

The span 'wall thickening of the extrahepatic and intrahepatic bile ducts' appears literally in the vignette (ultrasonography findings) and supports the intrahepatic and extrahepatic anatomical modifier of the diagnosis.

The span 'wall thickening of both extrahepatic and intrahepatic bile ducts with luminal narrowing and dilation' appears literally in the vignette (CT findings) and supports both the anatomical extent and the sclerosing cholangitis morphology in the completed label.

The span 'cholangiography via the drainage tube revealed strictures and dilatations with irregular wall contours in the intrahepatic bile ducts of both lobes, whereas extrahepatic bile-duct changes were modest' appears literally in the vignette and supports the intrahepatic and extrahepatic anatomical modifier, confirming involvement of both ductal systems.
